text:
Ruben Amorim admits Serie A is educational for him, as he is stunned by Frosinone’s tactical tweaks against Milan today. ‘There’s a lot of knowledge in this league, we need to be ready for anything.’
It kicks off at San Siro at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET).
The biggest problem for the Rossoneri this season has been consistency, as they seem to follow one strong performance with a disastrous result in the next, which has left them struggling in the Europa League more than Serie A.
Frosinone are without Antonio Raimondo, Florian Grillitsch and suspended Gabriele Bracaglia, but surprisingly opt for a False 9 system rather than starting Daniel Birligea upfront.
“The managers are really smart and know how to adapt to the opponent, there’s a lot of knowledge in this league. It’s fun, but on the other side we need to be ready for anything.”
Mike Maignan shook off a knock on international duty to start in goal, but Strahinja Pavlovic is still not at 100 per cent, with Matteo Gabbia, Samuel Chukwueze, Fikayo Tomori, Ruben Loftus-Cheek and Alexis Saelemaekers still injured.
It is a front three of Goncalo Ramos, Diego Moreira and Christian Pulisic, who were all in action for their countries last week, but are they suited together when Ramos works harder for the team than the team works for him?
“The most important thing if you see Roma, the principles and rotation of the team is more clear than for us. We need time to achieve that, and we had injuries that changed our way of playing, so we need time to work on every principle,” replied Amorim.
“The characteristics of the players are important, but Rabiot is a player who can give goals, Pulisic and Moreira can give goals, so it’s more the principles of the team and the rotation of the team than the characteristics of the players.
“Let’s see during the game, of course you can see the data and the runs behind are what we need to do more. We need to be more clear in the positions, so let’s see today.”
The transfer window is coming up in January, and RedBird patron Gerry Cardinale has made no secret of the fact he is pursuing Real Madrid talent Endrick.
Cardinale is having a very hands-on approach now, and is on the touchline during the warm-up chatting to former Milan player Simon Kjaer.
digest_he:
רובן אמורים מודה כי הליגה האיטלקית מהווה עבורו מקור ללמידה וכי הוא הופתע מהתאמות הטאקטיקה של פרוזינונה מול מילאן. לדבריו, מדובר בליגה עתירת ידע שבה צריך להיות מוכנים לכל תרחיש, והוא מציין כי קבוצתו עדיין זקוקה לזמן כדי להשיג את העקרונות והרוטציה הנדרשים.

אמורים מתייחס גם למצב הסגל ולפציעות הרבות שפקדו את השחקנים, תוך ציון העובדה ששחקנים כמו ראביו, פולישיץ' ומוריירה מסוגלים לספק שערים. במקביל, ג'רי קארדינאלה, פטרון רדבירד, ממשיך בגישה מעורבת ובוחן אפשרויות לקראת חלון ההעברות הקרוב בחודש ינואר.
